Sample order amount

Multiplies a made-up quantity, unit price and number of periods into a whole-number amount. It has no fixed values and no lookup tables, to exercise the calculator template without them.

What this tool does not cover

  • Every rule and number here is fictional. Do not use the result for a real order.

Your values

From 0 to 100000, whole numbers only.

From 0.00 to 1000.00, with up to 2 decimal places.

From 1 to 12, whole numbers only.

Result

Order amount
-

The result needs JavaScript and has not been worked out.

How the result is worked out

StepWhat it isHow it is worked outResultSource
1 Order amount Quantity in each period × Unit price × Number of periods, rounded to a whole number. - [1]
2 Amount for each period Order amount ÷ Number of periods, rounded to 1 decimal place. -

Every step uses exact decimal arithmetic. Where a step is rounded, a half is rounded away from zero: 0.125 to 2 decimal places is 0.13.
